npcs.name: Ora Softhands
npcs.description: Midwife associated with bedside lamps across town.
npcs.biography: Ask around town for a midwife and someone will point you to Ora at bedside lamps across town. At 54, this Human has learned which smiles are currency and which are warnings. Ora washes her hands as ritual and science, and is rarely without kit bag with lavender and clean linen. Trusted by many; link to Petra; saw Vale jewelry. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to train Petra as a proper clinic partner. What keeps them careful is losing a mother to pride or poverty. To a DM, Ora is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Delivered a child for a veiled woman who paid with a Vale cufflink.
npcs.personality: washes her hands as ritual and science. Professional demeanor of a seasoned midwife.
npcs.motivation: Pursue this: train Petra as a proper clinic partner. Avoid this: losing a mother to pride or poverty.
npcs.secret: Privately terrified of losing a mother to pride or poverty, and currently entangled with: Delivered a child for a veiled woman who paid with a Vale cufflink.
npcs.rumor: Rumor says Ora can tell you anything that happens near bedside lamps across town—for a price or a kindness.
npcs.voice: Speaks like a Human midwife: concrete details first, embellishment only when useful.
npcs.appearance: Human; often near bedside lamps across town; look for kit bag with lavender and clean linen.

npcs.name: Mol Deeprow
npcs.description: Gravedigger associated with the laddered graves behind chapel.
npcs.biography: Mol Deeprow works as a gravedigger out of the laddered graves behind chapel, a 49-year-old Human with more town memory than most council minutes. Mol whistles off-key to keep spirits uninterested, and is rarely without shovel with measurement notches. Works with Bram; holds physical evidence. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to keep the flood memorial neat for Bram. What keeps them careful is burying someone still claimed by the living. To a DM, Mol is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Buried Father Bram's 'nobody' and kept the Vale-cobbled boots in a hessian sack.

npcs.name: Skit Needlefang
npcs.description: Ratcatcher associated with alleys, cellars, and pantries.
npcs.biography: Skit Needlefang works as a ratcatcher out of alleys, cellars, and pantries, a 35-year-old Gnome with more town memory than most council minutes. Skit names rats before he catches them, and is rarely without cage of squeaks and a crooked grin. Knows Mouse's world from below; evidence for undercroft. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to be paid on contract by the council, not in scraps. What keeps them careful is plague talk turning into torch talk. To a DM, Skit is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Followed rat runs that revealed a chewed opening into the mill undercroft.

npcs.name: Bea Heartstring
npcs.description: Matchmaker associated with tea shops and festival dances.
npcs.biography: Bea Heartstring works as a matchmaker out of tea shops and festival dances, a 63-year-old Halfling with more town memory than most council minutes. Bea asks about siblings before asking about love, and is rarely without ribbon ledger of almost-engagements. Gossips with Issy; ships Pippa/Tomas; spotted Lysa's exit plan. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to see Pippa and Tomas dance without supervision. What keeps them careful is arranging a match that hides abuse. To a DM, Bea is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Noticed Lysa buying travel clothes 'for a cousin' who does not exist.
